results.title: When a chapter can't be shown
results.checks: Turning from John 3 to a John 4 that cannot be fetched says 'Chapter unavailable', 'We were unable to load the data for this chapter…', with Reload and Choose a translation; once it can be fetched, Reload shows it. /read/BSB/TOB/1 (Tobit is not in the BSB) says 'Book not found' — 'We couldn't find that book in Berean Standard Bible.' — and Go to Genesis 1 goes there
results.note: Chapter unavailable with Reload and Choose a translation, Reload brought John 4; Tobit: Book not found, Go to Genesis 1 went there
